scope: Independent read-only inspection of maintained broader conditional scientific source. No numerical/runtime producer launch or byte/reference acceptance inferred.
findings: The source-name presence axis, any contributing-label target presence and all contributing-label completeness remain distinct from the all-true hypothesis-conditioned mathematical input mask.
Each source count is allocated once, mapped plus residual NISP conserves reported NISP, and parent/child lexical conflicts refuse without claiming a fully authenticated taxonomic hierarchy.
Shared tree/dwarf birch merges source counts before applying one PPE target and one target covariance variable; it is an explicit parameter-transfer hypothesis, not independent species estimates.
Per-core factor cache is keyed by taxon and physical profile, so immutable geometry/wind/PPE alternatives may reuse exact factors without sharing writers or assuming independent taxa.
Accepted samples plus actual exclusion counts equal native samples; zero-panel windows are separately refused.
Baseline full covariance and all physical-profile point estimates/SE remain portable, while exact per-sample raw masks are retained in a separately hashed private artifact capsule.

Scientific interpretation remains the normalized mapped panel conditional on declared missing-row-zero and mutually-exclusive-partition hypotheses. Residual mass is not vegetation coverage; delta-method zero-cell SE is not absence or calibrated boundary uncertainty.

The original deterministic byte mismatch is an output serialization failure, preserved independently of the exact parsed numerical agreement. This inspection does not turn parsed equality into native byte acceptance.
limits: No taxonomy, historical LandClim reproduction, observed complete measurement, calibrated chronology/boundary/geometry uncertainty, ecological accuracy, native R parity, unfamiliar-reader qualification or rights admission established.
Actual maintained reference/replay, native source/import custody and independent new physical-factor results retain their separately declared receipts and scopes.
